fileId.description: The ID of the file to get info for.

filters.description: The filters to apply to the file info. Use them to reduce the size of the response.

items.description:
The fields to include in the response.

id - The file entry ID.
rootFolderId - The root folder ID of the file entry.
canShare - Specifies if the file entry can be shared or not.
security - The actions that can be performed with the file entry.
title - The file entry title.
access - The access rights to the file entry.
shared - Specifies if the file entry is shared or not.
created - The creation date and time of the file entry.
createdBy.id - The user ID.
createdBy.displayName - The user display name.
createdBy.isAnonim - Specifies if the user is anonymous or not.
fileEntryType - The file entry type.
folderId - The folder ID where the file is located.
fileType - The file type.
fileExst - The file extension.
comment - The comment to the file.
encrypted - Specifies if the file is encrypted or not.
locked - Specifies if the file is locked or not.
